nodes.label: Buehler, Some validity criteria for statistical inferences (1959)
nodes.author: R. J. Buehler
nodes.norm_label: buehler, some validity criteria for statistical inferences (1959)

nodes.label: Ka confidence view
nodes.rationale: Y axis titled Loss of Fit in Title Case by the owner's choice.

nodes.label: Measurements view
nodes.rationale: Units in the file is kept apart from Display unit because it reinterprets the numbers.

nodes.label: Plot appearance view
nodes.rationale: The form feeds no fit or analysis, so it stays open while one runs; means stay text-primary so no choice draws replicates in the means' colour.

nodes.label: Simulation view
nodes.rationale: Keeps its own copy of the binding model so exploring what-ifs never changes what the fit uses; measured data are never replaced.

nodes.label: Bradley's liberal criterion of robustness
nodes.rationale: Only the anti-conservative side can fail since a too-wide interval errs on the safe side.

nodes.label: conditional-coverage check
nodes.rationale: Closed coverage is judged too because users read a closed interval as a finite guarantee.

nodes.label: au = [signal] dimension fix
nodes.rationale: Dimensionless au made au/M identical to 1/M and shadowed astronomical_unit; a distinct dimension prevents the collision.

nodes.label: Never to_base_units for concentration
nodes.rationale: Molar's SI base is mol/m3, so to_base_units is 1000x off.

nodes.label: ParamKind parameter classification
nodes.rationale: Dimensional analysis alone cannot name a quantity; explicit kind plus [signal] dimension cross-checked by a test so neither drifts.

nodes.label: Quantities at edges, floats in core
nodes.norm_label: quantities at edges, floats in core
nodes.rationale: Per-iteration @ureg.wraps is 12.7x slower; boundary validation once per fit costs 1.01x and units are invariant across iterations.

nodes.label: Forward modeling approach
nodes.rationale: Linearizing transformations distort the error structure, giving biased estimates and unreliable confidence intervals.

nodes.label: Monotone Newton equilibrium solve
nodes.rationale: Under tight binding free concentration is decades below totals, so a relative stopping rule and minority-species balance are needed for relative accuracy.

nodes.label: Variable projection fit
nodes.rationale: Exhausting the Ka range rather than a starting guess handles multiple basins and makes the fit deterministic, at little cost.

nodes.label: Pint units audit
nodes.rationale: Column-name unit auto-detection excluded because a heuristic classifier could itself produce silent wrong conversions.

nodes.label: Fitting workflow flowchart (load data, generate parameter sets, optimize, filter by RMSE/R², aggregate per replica, save)
nodes.norm_label: fitting workflow flowchart (load data, generate parameter sets, optimize, filter by rmse/r2, aggregate per replica, save)

nodes.label: Two-component noise law
nodes.rationale: Preferred to a power law: contains constant/proportional noise exactly, share bounded in [0,1], handles zero signals, bounded weights.

nodes.label: Data meta data readme
nodes.rationale: Holding I0 and I_dye,free from the dye-alone measurement narrows the Ka(Guest) confidence interval because a change of Ka(Guest) is partly taken up by the coefficients.

nodes.label: axis_box()
nodes.rationale: Axes are sized from text metrics so the axes grow with the text and a title never meets a tick label.

nodes.label: PlotHeader
nodes.rationale: A breaking legend wraps between entries so no header needs the width of its whole legend.

nodes.label: PlotNavigation
nodes.rationale: A scroll without Cmd passes to the page so a scrolling canvas scrolls; theme change keeps user zoom.

nodes.label: SupraSimFit desktop app
nodes.rationale: Fits the raw signal with the full equilibrium model, with no Scatchard, Hill or double-reciprocal transform.

nodes.label: Sinn et al. 2019 CB8 indicator-displacement assay
nodes.norm_label: sinn et al. 2019 cb8 indicator-displacement assay

nodes.label: F-test profile interval
nodes.rationale: Numerical rank used instead of nominal parameter count because degenerate columns contribute one degree of freedom, not two.

nodes.label: Input-aware penalised profile interval
nodes.rationale: Effective degrees of freedom are used because input directions the data determine take residual degrees of freedom out of S.

nodes.label: fit_measurement_set
nodes.rationale: Fit goes through the interface's calls so what is scored is what ships.

nodes.label: Seed ladder 100→200→400
nodes.rationale: Stopping on a pass raises the chance of passing an anti-conservative case, so quoted rates rest on pooled family rows.

nodes.label: Result store (code-hashed jsonl)
nodes.rationale: Code hash covers numpy/scipy versions since numpy promises a random stream only within one build and scipy can move a solver; read-only modules are outside the hash so rewording costs no row.

nodes.label: Validation README
nodes.rationale: Nothing in a document is typed by hand from a remembered run; every quoted rate comes from this output.

nodes.label: Sobol' variance decomposition
nodes.rationale: log10 Ka decomposed because Ka varies multiplicatively; every sample kept since discarding poor ones biases toward entered inputs.

nodes.label: Input conflict statistic
nodes.rationale: Referring q to chi2_k as if all directions were informed makes the test dead.

nodes.label: Lack-of-fit F test and runs test
nodes.norm_label: lack-of-fit f test and runs test
nodes.rationale: Detrended scatter used because raw spread counts affine replicate differences as noise and makes the test unable to fire.

nodes.label: Holm-combined verdict
nodes.rationale: Interval always reported because withholding it would blank one good fit in twenty on a false alarm.

nodes.label: Replicate forward search and Cochran test
nodes.norm_label: replicate forward search and cochran test
nodes.rationale: Starting from majority nearest the median avoids a compromise K removing a good replicate; K test runs first so scatter false alarms do not keep shifted replicates.

nodes.label: Replicates averaged, not pooled
nodes.rationale: Pooling counts a shared systematic miss m times as independent evidence, narrowing the interval falsely.

nodes.label: One-step pretest for second constant
nodes.rationale: Weakly identified second step yields shallow profiles whose lower edges miss the truth too often.
